sources.title: ThorpyFX “The Bunker” Drive Pedal | GUITAR EFFECTS
sources.excerpt: ThorpyFX “The Bunker” Drive Pedal | GUITAR EFFECTS 0 YOUR CART $ 0.00 Home Vinyl Music CD LP Cassettes All Products Home / GUITAR EFFECTS / ThorpyFX “The Bunker” Drive Pedal ThorpyFX “The Bunker” Drive Pedal $269.00 $134.50 In Stock Quantity Add To Cart Share: SKU: A44877835 Category: GUITAR EFFECTS Description ThorpyFX The Bunker Drive The Bunker Drive is ThorpyFX's re-imagining of the legendary Lovetone Brown Source overdrive pedal. This MKII version is designed to be smaller and more tonally flexible while retaining the essence of the original circuit. With a unique Texture control, you can dial in a wide range of drive sounds, from the classic Brown Source style to a thicker, more harmonically rich and saturated tone, giving you a versatile palette of British-inspired crunch. The tone is further sculpted by a three-way toggle switch and a dedicated tone stack bypass footswitch, allowing you to seamlessly switch between two distinct sounds on the fly. Its construction is built for the road, featuring a rugged, custom-engineered enclosure with recessed knobs and top-mounted jacks, ensuring durability and a tidy pedalboard. The pedal's internal circuit is meticulously crafted with premium 1% metal film resistors and other high-end components to deliver a studio-quality sound that is both articulate and dynamic, cleaning up beautifully with your guitar's volume knob. Highlights Based on the classic Lovetone Brown Source circuit Texture control for a wide range of drive tones Dedicated footswitch to bypass the tone stack Robust, custom-engineered enclosure with recessed knobs Hand-built in the U.K. with premium components Specifications Controls : Volume, Drive, Tone, and Texture knobs Footswitches : One for on/off bypass and a second for Tone Stack Bypass Toggle Switch : A three-way switch for tonal character Power : 9-volt DC, standard negative center Enclosure : Laser-cut black anodized aluminum with a metallic brown base Dimensions : (W) 65mm x (L) 125mm x (H) 53mm Please feel free to reach out to our knowledgeable sales staff with any additional questions!
